translator_notes: 'Седмојанче', 'трлави пенушки' (rendered 'rough logs') and 'ковчави ореви' (rendered 'hard walnuts') are my reading of dialect words. 'Лудо' is an affectionate 'fool/dear' address.

lines.en: Hey girl, girl, girl of seven,

lines.cyr: од кога си моме на седом години?
lines.lat: od koga si mome na sedom godini?
lines.en: since when are you, girl, seven years old?
Hey girl, girl, girl of seven,

lines.cyr: зошчо ти се моме, плешчи згрбавени?
lines.lat: zoščo ti se mome, plešči zgrbaveni?
lines.en: why, girl, are your shoulders hunched?

lines.cyr: Море лудо, лудо, море ти бре младо,
lines.lat: More ludo, ludo, more ti bre mlado,
lines.en: Hey fool, fool, hey you young one,
walking, fool, up in the mountain,
walking, fool, up in the mountain,
carrying, fool, rough logs.
Hey girl, girl, girl of seven,

lines.cyr: зошчо ти се моме, зоби попаѓани.
lines.lat: zoščo ti se mome, zobi popaǵani.
lines.en: why, girl, are your teeth fallen out?

lines.cyr: Море лудо, лудо, море ти бре младо,
lines.lat: More ludo, ludo, more ti bre mlado,
lines.en: Hey fool, fool, hey you young one,
eating, fool, hard walnuts.
Hey girl, girl, girl of seven,

lines.cyr: зошчо ти се моме коси побелени?
lines.lat: zoščo ti se mome kosi pobeleni?
lines.en: why, girl, has your hair turned white?
Hey girl, girl, girl of seven,

lines.cyr: зошчо ти се моме коси побелени?
lines.lat: zoščo ti se mome kosi pobeleni?
lines.en: why, girl, has your hair turned white?

lines.cyr: Оре лудо, лудо, море ти бре младо,
lines.lat: Ore ludo, ludo, more ti bre mlado,
lines.en: Hey fool, fool, hey you young one,
sitting, fool, down in the watermills.
The wind blew on me, my hair turned white,
